description: This file defines the 'perf_postgres' class for performance monitoring and tuning PostgreSQL databases within the broader ADODB library. It includes SQL queries for database metrics, performance statistics, and cache details, as well as methods for explaining SQL statement execution plans.

classes.name: perf_postgres
classes.description: A class extending adodb_perf, specialized for monitoring and tuning PostgreSQL databases, providing SQL queries for system metrics and an explain plan method.

methods.name: perf_postgres
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the class with a database connection.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Executes EXPLAIN on a SQL query to retrieve its execution plan, optionally handling partial explanations.
